to_five: hs land: when the land is undone by a concurrent land, automatically sync and re-land (re-running --check) instead of exiting 1, at least when the only overlap is merge=union files like NOTES.md

Make `hs land`/`hs sync` print what they are fetching and from whom, time out after ~20 s with the missing object named, and keep `hs status`/`hs log` purely local; with that I would have landed in seconds (git push would have).

`hs watch --path X` (and `hs claims`) should report the owner's presence/WIP for that path (e.g. 'a2 online, editing /src/scheduler.js uncommitted, last seen 10s ago') so waiting on a dependency is informed.

When a land touches /.hsreview-protected paths, hs land should land the unprotected files and turn the protected ones into a proposal to the required reviewers in one step (e.g. hs land --split-review). Missing-block errors should retry or wait for the hub instead of failing immediately, and should agree with hs doctor.

hs should fetch the missing main-view blocks from the connected hub automatically on any command (hs fetch with progress and a timeout as the fallback), and hs doctor should flag it, so a connected hub never leaves the worktree unusable.

hs land should fetch missing index blocks from the hub itself (retry until timeout) instead of failing, and an approval event should only print 'approved' when the current revision actually counts it (show 'approved rev 0, rev 1 needs re-approval' otherwise)
hs land --split-protected: land the unprotected paths now and automatically open a proposal (reviewers taken from /.hsreview) for the protected ones, landing it when approved

When a provisional land is dropped or never reaches a holder, hs status / next command / feed should print '!! your land #57 was lost (never reached a holder): run hs land' and auto-retry it on the next online command; and hs land --paths to land files independently of a pending proposal.

When a land touches /.hsreview paths without approval, land the rest and auto-create the proposal for the protected paths (e.g. hs land --split-protected: 'landed #87 (5 files); proposed P3 for /CONTRACTS.md, asked ann').
